title: Europa League winning managers, 2001 to 2010
brief: Name the manager who won the UEFA Cup (the Europa League from 2010) each year.
period: UEFA Cup and Europa League finals, 2001 to 2010
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_UEFA_Cup_and_Europa_League_finals (each final's own article, manager in the line-ups)
checks: Transfermarkt's list of winning coaches against the manager named in each final's Wikipedia article; UEFA's line-ups feed names the coach for most finals from 2008 and agrees, except 2018 where it names Simeone's assistant German Burgos (Simeone was banned from the touchline).
